## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] New behavior has tests (a passing and a failing case)
- [ ] New or changed rules are documented in `docs/rules.md`, and no rule ID was reused
- [ ] No real HAR files, tokens, emails, or tenant IDs (fixtures are synthetic; see `testdata/README.md`)
- [ ] No new dependencies, or the dependency was agreed in an issue first
